scope: Resolve GICL, VITAL and KOTYARK 2026 observations using issuer-specific official NSE/issuer evidence, while preserving each issuer's earlier SME IPO history and source conflicts.

decisions.reason: NSE's listing approval explicitly states that GICL's equity shares were admitted to the Main Board effective 18-Feb-2026 pursuant to migration from the SME Emerge platform.

historical_ipo.note: Older SME IPO history remains separate. The retained past feed carries 30-Sep-2016 to 07-Oct-2016; the issuer's later official documents confirm the company was already NSE SME-listed before the 2026 migration.

preserved_conflicts: A 2025 official filing shows prior ISIN INE947T01014; NSE then changed the ISIN to INE947T01022 effective 15-Oct-2025 after a face-value split from Rs.10 to Rs.5. The 2026 migration uses the new ISIN and is not a new IPO.
The aggregate past-issues row combines the old 2016 offer period with the 18-Feb-2026 migration listing date and must not be interpreted as a 2026 IPO.

decisions.reason: An official issuer filing to NSE states that the company was earlier listed on NSE's SME Platform (EMERGE) and its equity shares were listed on the Main Board effective 11-Mar-2026 upon migration.

historical_ipo.note: Retained NSE issuer detail explicitly calls the 2022 transaction an Initial Public offer; NSE Market Pulse classifies Vital's 14-Nov-2022 listing as SME-IPO.

preserved_conflicts: The retained 2022 issuer detail gives a price range of Rs.95–101 while the aggregate past-issues row reports issuePrice 46. This price conflict is preserved and is irrelevant to classifying the 2026 event as migration.
The 11-Mar-2026 date is a Main Board migration date, not a new IPO listing date.

decisions.reason: NSE Circular NSE/CML/73219 explicitly states that KOTYARK would migrate from SME Platform (EMERGE) to the Capital Market Segment (Main Board) effective 12-Mar-2026 and references its original 2021 SME listing circular.
preserved_conflicts: The aggregate past-issues row reports issuePrice 281 while issuer financial statements state that the 2021 IPO was issued at Rs.51. The conflict is preserved; the issuer statement is direct evidence of the original IPO.
The 12-Mar-2026 observation is migration to Main Board, not a new IPO.

integrity.note: Original PDF bytes were not materialized in this connector review. Literal official-source projections are retained with SHA-256 hashes of those projections only; no projection hash is represented as an original-file hash.

notes: This review classifies the 2026 exchange events only. It does not delete or overwrite the issuers' earlier SME IPO histories.
No parser/adapter change was required, so no parser regression test was added.
No public IPO record is added, removed or edited by this review.
